description: This file defines the DevelopmentClusteringProvider class, which implements IProviderBuilder for configuring development clustering in Orleans Silo. It includes a method to parse configuration settings and set up the clustering endpoint.

classes.name: DevelopmentClusteringProvider
classes.description: Implements IProviderBuilder for configuring development clustering in Orleans Silo.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the silo builder with development clustering settings, parsing the PrimarySiloEndPoint from configuration.
